```kt
private fun truthy(v: String?): Boolean? = when (v?.trim()?.lowercase()) {
    "1", "true", "yes", "enabled", "available" -> true
    "0", "false", "no", "disabled" -> false
    else -> null
}

@Composable
private fun boolRow(label: String, raw: String?, meaning: String, trueGood: Boolean = true) {
    val b = truthy(raw)
    val disp = when (b) {
        true -> stringResource(R.string.v_yes)
        false -> stringResource(R.string.v_no)
        null -> raw ?: stringResource(R.string.v_unknown)
    }
    val tone = when (b) {
        null -> Tone.NEUTRAL
        true -> if (trueGood) Tone.GOOD else Tone.BAD
        false -> if (trueGood) Tone.BAD else Tone.GOOD
    }
    InfoRow(label, disp, tone, meaning)
}

@Composable
private fun Loader() {
    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
        CircularProgressIndicator()
    }
}

private fun pageModifier() = Modifier
    .fillMaxSize()
    .padding(horizontal = 16.dp)

@Composable
private fun imsRow(label: String, raw: String?, meaning: String, neutral: Boolean) {
    if (!neutral) {
        boolRow(label, raw, meaning)
    } else {
        val disp = when (truthy(raw)) {
            true -> stringResource(R.string.v_yes)
            false -> stringResource(R.string.v_no)
            null -> raw
        }
        InfoRow(label, disp, Tone.NEUTRAL, meaning)
    }
}

@Composable
fun RcsScreen(data: RcsData?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    if (data == null) {
        Loader(); return
    }
    Column(modifier.then(pageModifier()).verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())) {
        val (healthWord, healthTone) = when (data.health) {
            RcsHealth.CONNECTED -> R.string.rcs_st_connected to Tone.GOOD
            RcsHealth.OFF -> R.string.rcs_st_off to Tone.BAD
            else -> R.string.rcs_st_setup to Tone.WARN
        }
        val connected = data.health == RcsHealth.CONNECTED
        val magicOk = truthy(data.magicCompose) == true
        StatusStrip(
            listOf(
                stringResource(R.string.rcs_chip_active) to healthTone,
                stringResource(R.string.rcs_chip_backend) to (if (data.imsPkgPresent || connected) Tone.GOOD else Tone.WARN),
                stringResource(R.string.rcs_chip_gemini) to (if (connected) Tone.GOOD else Tone.WARN),
                stringResource(R.string.rcs_chip_magic) to (if (magicOk) Tone.GOOD else Tone.WARN),
            ),
        )

        if (data.health != RcsHealth.CONNECTED && data.mVersion == "0") {
            KeyCallout(stringResource(R.string.rcs_callout_mversion_zero), Tone.BAD)
        }

        SectionTitle(stringResource(R.string.rcs_sec_status))
        InfoCard {
            InfoRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_connected), stringResource(healthWord), healthTone, stringResource(R.string.rcs_connected_m))
            InfoRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_carrier), data.carrier, Tone.NEUTRAL, stringResource(R.string.rcs_carrier_m))
            val availWord = when (truthy(data.available)) {
                true -> stringResource(R.string.v_yes)
                false -> stringResource(R.string.v_no)
                null -> data.available
            }
            InfoRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_available), availWord, Tone.NEUTRAL, stringResource(R.string.rcs_available_m))
            if (data.selfNumber != null) {
                RevealRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_self_number), data.selfNumber, stringResource(R.string.rcs_self_number_m))
            }
            InfoRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_state), data.rcsState, Tone.NEUTRAL, stringResource(R.string.rcs_state_m))
            InfoRow(
                stringResource(R.string.rcs_cfg_version),
                data.mVersion,
                if (data.mVersion == "0") (if (connected) Tone.NEUTRAL else Tone.BAD) else if (data.mVersion != null) Tone.GOOD else Tone.NEUTRAL,
                stringResource(R.string.rcs_cfg_version_m),
            )
            val invalidReason = data.invalidConfigReason?.takeIf { !it.endsWith("UNSPECIFIED") }
            if (invalidReason != null) {
                InfoRow(
                    stringResource(R.string.rcs_invalid_reason),
                    invalidReason.removePrefix("INVALID_CONFIG_REASON_"),
                    Tone.WARN,
                    stringResource(R.string.rcs_invalid_reason_m),
                )
            }
            InfoRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_capable), data.capableContacts, Tone.NEUTRAL, stringResource(R.string.rcs_capable_m))
            imsRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_flag_enabled), data.flagEnabled, stringResource(R.string.rcs_flag_enabled_m), connected)
            if (data.health != RcsHealth.CONNECTED) {
                boolRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_flag_unavailable), data.flagUnavailable, stringResource(R.string.rcs_flag_unavailable_m), trueGood = false)
            }
            InfoRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_entitlement), data.entitlement, Tone.NEUTRAL, stringResource(R.string.rcs_entitlement_m))
            imsRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_uce), data.uce, stringResource(R.string.rcs_uce_m), connected)
            imsRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_ims_pkg), if (data.imsPkgPresent) "true" else "false", stringResource(R.string.rcs_ims_pkg_m), connected)
        }

        SectionTitle(stringResource(R.string.rcs_gemini_sec))
        InfoCard {
            boolRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_magic_compose), data.magicCompose, stringResource(R.string.rcs_magic_compose_m))
            boolRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_aicore), if (data.aicorePresent) "true" else "false", stringResource(R.string.rcs_aicore_m))
            InfoRow(
                stringResource(R.string.rcs_gemini_chat),
                stringResource(if (connected) R.string.v_yes else R.string.v_no),
                if (connected) Tone.GOOD else Tone.WARN,
                stringResource(R.string.rcs_gemini_chat_m),
            )
        }

        SectionTitle(stringResource(R.string.rcs_sec_times))
        InfoCard {
            InfoRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_cfg_updated), Fmt.tsSecs(data.cfgUpdSecs), Tone.NEUTRAL, stringResource(R.string.rcs_cfg_updated_m))
            InfoRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_cfg_validity), Fmt.durationSecs(data.cfgValiditySecs), Tone.NEUTRAL, stringResource(R.string.rcs_cfg_validity_m))
            InfoRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_token_exp), Fmt.tsMs(data.tokenExpMs), Tone.NEUTRAL, stringResource(R.string.rcs_token_exp_m))
            InfoRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_prov_last), Fmt.tsSecs(data.provLastSecs), Tone.NEUTRAL, stringResource(R.string.rcs_prov_last_m))
            InfoRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_prov_next), Fmt.tsSecs(data.provNextSecs), Tone.NEUTRAL, stringResource(R.string.rcs_prov_next_m))
            InfoRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_msg_last), Fmt.tsMs(data.msgLastMs), Tone.NEUTRAL, stringResource(R.string.rcs_msg_last_m))
            InfoRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_cap_refresh), Fmt.tsMs(data.capRefreshMs), Tone.NEUTRAL, stringResource(R.string.rcs_cap_refresh_m))
            InfoRow(stringResource(R.string.rcs_full_sync), Fmt.tsMs(data.fullSyncMs), Tone.NEUTRAL, stringResource(R.string.rcs_full_sync_m))

@Composable
fun WalletScreen(data: WalletData?, onReset: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    if (data == null) {
        Loader(); return
    }
    var confirmReset by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var showInfo by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    Column(modifier.then(pageModifier()).verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())) {
        val attTone = when (truthy(data.attested)) {
            true -> Tone.GOOD
            false -> Tone.BAD
            null -> Tone.NEUTRAL
        }
        Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            Box(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                StatusStrip(
                    listOf(
                        stringResource(R.string.wallet_chip_attested) to attTone,
                        stringResource(R.string.wallet_chip_nfc) to (if (data.hasNfc) Tone.GOOD else Tone.WARN),
                    ),
                )
            }
            Button(
                onClick = { confirmReset = true },
                contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 14.dp),
            ) {
                Icon(Icons.Outlined.RestartAlt, null, Modifier.size(18.dp))
                Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
                Text(stringResource(R.string.wallet_reset_confirm))
            }
            IconButton(onClick = { showInfo = true }) {
                Icon(Icons.Outlined.Info, stringResource(R.string.action_info))
            }
        }

        if (confirmReset) {
            AlertDialog(
                onDismissRequest = { confirmReset = false },
                title = { Text(stringResource(R.string.wallet_reset_btn)) },
                text = { Text(stringResource(R.string.wallet_reset_msg)) },
                confirmButton = {
                    TextButton(onClick = { confirmReset = false; onReset() }) {

                },
                dismissButton = {
                    TextButton(onClick = { confirmReset = false }) {
                        Text(stringResource(R.string.wallet_reset_cancel))
                    }
                },
            )
        }
        if (showInfo) {
            AlertDialog(
                onDismissRequest = { showInfo = false },
                title = { Text(stringResource(R.string.wallet_reset_btn)) },
                text = { Text(stringResource(R.string.wallet_reset_info)) },
                confirmButton = {
                    TextButton(onClick = { showInfo = false }) {
                        Text(stringResource(R.string.action_close))
                    }
                },
            )
        }

        SectionTitle(stringResource(R.string.wallet_sec_device))
        InfoCard {
            boolRow(stringResource(R.string.wallet_nfc), if (data.hasNfc) "true" else "false", stringResource(R.string.wallet_nfc_m))
            boolRow(stringResource(R.string.wallet_pkg), if (data.walletPkgPresent) "true" else "false", stringResource(R.string.wallet_pkg_m))
        }

        SectionTitle(stringResource(R.string.wallet_sec_att))
        InfoCard {
            boolRow(stringResource(R.string.wallet_attested), data.attested, stringResource(R.string.wallet_attested_m))
            InfoRow(stringResource(R.string.wallet_attested_time), Fmt.tsMs(data.attestedTimeMs), Tone.NEUTRAL, stringResource(R.string.wallet_attested_time_m))
            boolRow(stringResource(R.string.wallet_service), data.serviceEnabled, stringResource(R.string.wallet_service_m))
            boolRow(stringResource(R.string.wallet_tapandpay), data.tapAndPayEnabled, stringResource(R.string.wallet_tapandpay_m))
            boolRow(stringResource(R.string.wallet_password), data.passwordSufficient, stringResource(R.string.wallet_password_m))
            boolRow(stringResource(R.string.wallet_token), data.hadToken, stringResource(R.string.wallet_token_m))

        TzFooter()

private class AppMeta(val label: String?, val icon: ImageBitmap?)

@Composable
fun AttScreen(data: AttData?, onReload: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    if (data == null) {
        Loader(); return
    }
    val apps = data.apps
    val ctx = LocalContext.current
    val meta by produceState(emptyMap<String, AppMeta>(), apps) {
        value = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { apps.associate { it.pkg to resolveMeta(ctx, it) } }
    }
    var query by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    Column(modifier.then(pageModifier()).verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())) {
        Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            Box(Modifier.weight(1f)) { SectionTitle(stringResource(R.string.att_sec_apps)) }
            IconButton(onClick = onReload) {
                Icon(Icons.Outlined.Refresh, stringResource(R.string.action_reload))
            }
        }
        if (apps.isEmpty()) {
            NoteText(stringResource(R.string.att_empty))
        } else {
            NoteText(stringResource(R.string.att_intro))
            OutlinedTextField(
                value = query,
                onValueChange = { query = it },
                singleLine = true,
                leadingIcon = { Icon(Icons.Outlined.Search, null) },
                trailingIcon = {
                    if (query.isNotEmpty()) {
                        IconButton(onClick = { query = "" }) {
                            Icon(Icons.Outlined.Close, stringResource(R.string.action_close))
                        }
                    }
                },
                placeholder = { Text(stringResource(R.string.att_search)) },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 8.dp),
            )
            val q = query.trim()
            val shown = if (q.isEmpty()) apps else apps.filter {
                it.pkg.contains(q, ignoreCase = true) ||
                    (meta[it.pkg]?.label?.contains(q, ignoreCase = true) == true)
            }
            Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                for (a in shown) AttCard(a, meta[a.pkg])
            }
        }
        TzFooter()
    }
}

@Composable
fun DgScreen(data: AttData?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    if (data == null) {
        Loader(); return
    }
    Column(modifier.then(pageModifier()).verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())) {
        SectionTitle(stringResource(R.string.att_sec_cert))
        InfoCard {
            boolRow(stringResource(R.string.att_cert), data.certified, stringResource(R.string.att_cert_m))
        }
        if (data.droidGuard.isNotEmpty()) {
            SectionTitle(stringResource(R.string.att_sec_dg))
            NoteText(stringResource(R.string.att_dg_intro))
            InfoCard {
                for (f in data.droidGuard) {
                    InfoRow(
                        f.flow,
                        Fmt.tsSecs(f.expirySecs),
                        Tone.NEUTRAL,
                        stringResource(R.string.att_dg_valid, Fmt.durationSecs(f.expirySecs - f.issuedSecs) ?: "-"),
                    )
                }
            }
        }
        TzFooter()
    }
}

private fun resolveMeta(ctx: android.content.Context, a: AttApp): AppMeta {
    val pm = ctx.packageManager
    val info = a.apkPath?.let { runCatching { pm.getPackageArchiveInfo(it, 0) }.getOrNull() }
    info?.applicationInfo?.apply {
        sourceDir = a.apkPath
        publicSourceDir = a.apkPath
    }
    val icon = info?.applicationInfo?.let { runCatching { it.loadIcon(pm) }.getOrNull() }
    val label = info?.applicationInfo?.let { runCatching { it.loadLabel(pm).toString() }.getOrNull() }
    return AppMeta(label, icon?.toBmp()?.asImageBitmap())
}

@Composable
private fun AttCard(a: AttApp, meta: AppMeta?) {
    Row(
        Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
            .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant.copy(alpha = 0.4f))
            .padding(14.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
        val bmp = meta?.icon
        Box(
            Modifier.size(44.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
            if (bmp != null) {
                Image(bmp, null, Modifier.size(44.dp))
            } else {
                Icon(Icons.Outlined.Android, null, tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
            }
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.width(14.dp))
        Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Text(
                meta?.label ?: a.pkg,
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
            )
            Text(
                a.pkg,
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            )
            Spacer(Modifier.size(6.dp))
            Text(
                stringResource(R.string.att_last_call, Fmt.tsMs(a.lastCallMs) ?: "-"),
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            )
            Text(
                stringResource(R.string.att_calls, a.calls),
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            )
        }
    }
}

private fun Drawable.toBmp(): Bitmap {
    if (this is BitmapDrawable && bitmap != null) return bitmap
    val w = intrinsicWidth.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 96
    val h = intrinsicHeight.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 96
    val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(w, h, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
    val c = Canvas(bmp)
    setBounds(0, 0, c.width, c.height)
    draw(c)
    return bmp
}
```

```kt
import android.os.Build

private val LightScheme = lightColorScheme(
    primary = LightPrimary,
    onPrimary = LightOnPrimary,
    primaryContainer = LightPrimaryContainer,

    onPrimary = DarkOnPrimary,
    primaryContainer = DarkPrimaryContainer,

    secondaryContainer = DarkSecondaryContainer,

data class StateColors(val good: Color, val bad: Color, val warn: Color)

@Composable
fun stateColors(): StateColors {
    val dark = isSystemInDarkTheme()
    return StateColors(
        good = if (dark) GoodDark else Good,
        bad = if (dark) BadDark else Bad,
        warn = if (dark) WarnDark else Warn,
    )
}

@Composable
fun VDGoogleTheme(darkOverride: Boolean? = null, content: @Composable () -> Unit) {
    val dark = darkOverride ?: isSystemInDarkTheme()
    val ctx = LocalContext.current
    val scheme = when {
        Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S ->
            if (dark) dynamicDarkColorScheme(ctx) else dynamicLightColorScheme(ctx)
        dark -> DarkScheme
        else -> LightScheme
    }
    MaterialTheme(colorScheme = scheme, typography = Typography, content = content)
}
```

```kt
/*
 * ======================================================================
 *  VD GOOGLE  ::  your Google services, read on-device
 *  RCS, Google Wallet and Play Integrity attestations: local, no internet.
 *
 *  Copyright (C) 2026  VD171
 *  SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later
 *
 *  Free software under the GNU AGPL v3 or later. NETWORK COPYLEFT: run a
 *  modified version, even as a service, and you MUST offer its source.
 *
 *  Site           : https://vd171.ru
 *  Site           : https://vd.priv8.ru
 *  Source         : https://github.com/VD171/VD-Google
 *  GitHub         : @VD171 https://github.com/VD171
 *  XDA-Developers : @VD171 https://xdaforums.com/m/vd171.4699873/
 *  XDA thread     : https://xdaforums.com/t/VD-Google.4803837/
 *  Telegram       : @VD_Priv8 https://t.me/VD_Priv8
 *  Channel        : @Priv8_VD https://t.me/Priv8_VD
 *  Discord        : @VD.Priv8 https://discord.com/users/1296831918989639721
 *  E-mail         : vd.priv8@pm.me
 * ======================================================================
 */
package ru.vd171.vdgoogle.util

import android.content.Context
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import ru.vd171.vdgoogle.BuildConfig
import java.io.File

object ActionLog {

    private const val FILE = "actions.json"
    private const val MAX = 200

    fun file(ctx: Context): File = File(ctx.filesDir, FILE)

    fun record(ctx: Context, action: String, ok: Boolean) {
        runCatching {
            val f = file(ctx)
            val arr = if (f.exists()) JSONArray(f.readText()) else JSONArray()
            arr.put(
                JSONObject()
                    .put("time", Fmt.tsMs(System.currentTimeMillis()))
                    .put("action", action)
                    .put("ok", ok)
                    .put("appVersion", BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME),
            )
            val trimmed = if (arr.length() > MAX) {
                JSONArray().apply { for (i in arr.length() - MAX until arr.length()) put(arr.get(i)) }
            } else {
                arr
            }
            f.writeText(trimmed.toString(2))
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
/*
 * ======================================================================
 *  VD GOOGLE  ::  your Google services, read on-device
 *  RCS, Google Wallet and Play Integrity attestations: local, no internet.
 *
 *  Copyright (C) 2026  VD171
 *  SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later
 *
 *  Free software under the GNU AGPL v3 or later. NETWORK COPYLEFT: run a
 *  modified version, even as a service, and you MUST offer its source.
 *
 *  Site           : https://vd171.ru
 *  Site           : https://vd.priv8.ru
 *  Source         : https://github.com/VD171/VD-Google
 *  GitHub         : @VD171 https://github.com/VD171
 *  XDA-Developers : @VD171 https://xdaforums.com/m/vd171.4699873/
 *  XDA thread     : https://xdaforums.com/t/VD-Google.4803837/
 *  Telegram       : @VD_Priv8 https://t.me/VD_Priv8
 *  Channel        : @Priv8_VD https://t.me/Priv8_VD
 *  Discord        : @VD.Priv8 https://discord.com/users/1296831918989639721
 *  E-mail         : vd.priv8@pm.me
 * ======================================================================
 */
package ru.vd171.vdgoogle.util

import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import org.json.JSONObject
import ru.vd171.vdgoogle.BuildConfig
import ru.vd171.vdgoogle.data.RcsData
import ru.vd171.vdgoogle.data.WalletData

object Export {

    private fun jb(raw: String?): Any = when (raw?.trim()?.lowercase()) {
        "1", "true", "yes", "enabled", "available" -> true
        "0", "false", "no", "disabled" -> false
        null, "" -> JSONObject.NULL
        else -> raw
    }

    private fun jn(raw: String?): Any =
        raw?.trim()?.toLongOrNull() ?: (raw?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: JSONObject.NULL)

    private fun js(raw: String?): Any = raw?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: JSONObject.NULL

    private fun jauto(v: String): Any = when (v) {
        "true" -> true
        "false" -> false
        else -> v.toLongOrNull() ?: v
    }

    private fun toJson(v: Any?): Any = when (v) {
        null -> JSONObject.NULL
        is Map<*, *> -> JSONObject().also { o -> for ((k, vv) in v) o.put(k.toString(), toJson(vv)) }
        is List<*> -> org.json.JSONArray().also { a -> for (e in v) a.put(toJson(e)) }
        else -> v
    }

    fun buildReport(rcs: RcsData?, wallet: WalletData?, diag: Map<String, Any?>? = null): String {
        val root = JSONObject()
        root.put("app", "VD Google")
        root.put("version", BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME)
        root.put("exportedAt", js(Fmt.tsMs(System.currentTimeMillis())))
        root.put(
            "device",
            JSONObject()
                .put("manufacturer", Build.MANUFACTURER)
                .put("model", Build.MODEL)
                .put("androidRelease", Build.VERSION.RELEASE)
                .put("sdk", Build.VERSION.SDK_INT),
        )
        root.put("timezone", Fmt.timezoneLabel())

        rcs?.let {
            val r = JSONObject()
            r.put("carrier", js(it.carrier))
            r.put("connected", it.health.name.lowercase())
            r.put("rcsEnabled", jb(it.rcsEnabled))
            r.put("engineState", js(it.engineState))
            r.put("provisioningStatusPev2", jn(it.provStatusPev2))
            r.put("transportRegistered", it.tachyonRegistered)
            r.put("available", jb(it.available))
            r.put("state", jn(it.rcsState))
            r.put("configVersion", jn(it.mVersion))
            r.put("configState", jn(it.configState))
            r.put("invalidConfigReason", js(it.invalidConfigReason))
            r.put("capableContacts", jn(it.capableContacts))
            r.put("featureEnabled", jb(it.flagEnabled))
            r.put("markedUnavailable", jb(it.flagUnavailable))
            r.put("carrierEntitlement", jb(it.entitlement))
            r.put("presenceUce", jb(it.uce))
            r.put("imsServicePresent", it.imsPkgPresent)
            r.put("configUpdated", js(Fmt.tsSecs(it.cfgUpdSecs)))
            r.put("configValidity", js(Fmt.durationSecs(it.cfgValiditySecs)))
            r.put("tokenExpiration", js(Fmt.tsMs(it.tokenExpMs)))
            r.put("lastProvisioning", js(Fmt.tsSecs(it.provLastSecs)))
            r.put("nextProvisioning", js(Fmt.tsSecs(it.provNextSecs)))
            r.put("lastRcsMessage", js(Fmt.tsMs(it.msgLastMs)))
            r.put("capabilitiesRefreshed", js(Fmt.tsMs(it.capRefreshMs)))
            r.put("fullSync", js(Fmt.tsMs(it.fullSyncMs)))
            r.put("lastSync", js(Fmt.tsMs(it.lastSyncMs)))
            if (it.provConfig.isNotEmpty()) {
                val prov = JSONObject()
                for ((k, v) in it.provConfig) prov.put(k, jauto(v))
                r.put("provisioning", prov)
            }
            root.put("rcs", r)
        }

        wallet?.let {
            val w = JSONObject()
            w.put("deviceAttested", jb(it.attested))
            w.put("lastChecked", js(Fmt.tsMs(it.attestedTimeMs)))
            w.put("nfcHardware", it.hasNfc)
            w.put("walletInstalled", it.walletPkgPresent)
            w.put("walletService", jb(it.serviceEnabled))
            w.put("tapAndPay", jb(it.tapAndPayEnabled))
            w.put("screenLockAccepted", jb(it.passwordSufficient))
            w.put("cardEverAdded", jb(it.hadToken))
            root.put("wallet", w)
        }

        if (diag != null) root.put("diagnostics", toJson(diag))

        return root.toString(2)
    }

    fun share(ctx: Context, text: String) {
        val send = Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND).apply {
            type = "text/plain"
            putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_SUBJECT, "VD Google export")
            putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT, text)
        }
        runCatching { ctx.startActivity(Intent.createChooser(send, null)) }
    }

    fun writeTo(ctx: Context, uri: Uri, text: String) {
        runCatching { ctx.contentResolver.openOutputStream(uri)?.use { it.write(text.toByteArray()) } }
    }
}
```

`VDGoogle/app/src/main/java/ru/vd171/vdgoogle/util/Fmt.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * ======================================================================
 *  VD GOOGLE  ::  your Google services, read on-device
 *  RCS, Google Wallet and Play Integrity attestations: local, no internet.
 *
 *  Copyright (C) 2026  VD171
 *  SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later
 *
 *  Free software under the GNU AGPL v3 or later. NETWORK COPYLEFT: run a
 *  modified version, even as a service, and you MUST offer its source.
 *
 *  Site           : https://vd171.ru
 *  Site           : https://vd.priv8.ru
 *  Source         : https://github.com/VD171/VD-Google
 *  GitHub         : @VD171 https://github.com/VD171
 *  XDA-Developers : @VD171 https://xdaforums.com/m/vd171.4699873/
 *  XDA thread     : https://xdaforums.com/t/VD-Google.4803837/
 *  Telegram       : @VD_Priv8 https://t.me/VD_Priv8
 *  Channel        : @Priv8_VD https://t.me/Priv8_VD
 *  Discord        : @VD.Priv8 https://discord.com/users/1296831918989639721
 *  E-mail         : vd.priv8@pm.me
 * ======================================================================
 */
package ru.vd171.vdgoogle.util

import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale
import java.util.TimeZone

object Fmt {

    private fun formatter(): SimpleDateFormat =
        SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault()).apply { timeZone = TimeZone.getDefault() }

    fun tsMs(ms: Long?): String? = ms?.takeIf { it > 0L }?.let { formatter().format(Date(it)) }

    fun tsSecs(s: Long?): String? = tsMs(s?.let { it * 1000L })

    fun exportFileName(): String {
        val ts = SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd-HHmm", Locale.US).format(Date())
        return "vdgoogle-$ts.json"
    }

    fun timezoneLabel(): String {
        val tz = TimeZone.getDefault()
        val off = tz.getOffset(System.currentTimeMillis())
        val sign = if (off >= 0) "+" else "-"
        val abs = Math.abs(off)
        val hh = abs / 3_600_000
        val mm = (abs / 60_000) % 60
        val gmt = "GMT%s%02d:%02d".format(sign, hh, mm)
        val abbr = tz.getDisplayName(tz.inDaylightTime(Date()), TimeZone.SHORT, Locale.getDefault())
        return if (abbr.isBlank() || abbr == gmt || abbr.startsWith("GMT")) gmt else "$gmt ($abbr)"
    }

    fun maskNumber(value: String): String {
        val tail = value.takeLast(4)
        return "•••• $tail"
    }

    fun durationSecs(secs: Long?): String? {
        if (secs == null || secs <= 0L) return null
        val d = secs / 86_400
        val h = (secs % 86_400) / 3_600
        val m = (secs % 3_600) / 60
        return buildString {
            if (d > 0) append("${d}d ")
            if (h > 0) append("${h}h ")
            if (m > 0 || isEmpty()) append("${m}m")
        }.trim()
    }
}
```

```kt
/*
 * ======================================================================
 *  VD GOOGLE  ::  your Google services, read on-device
 *  RCS, Google Wallet and Play Integrity attestations: local, no internet.
 *
 *  Copyright (C) 2026  VD171
 *  SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later

 *  Free software under the GNU AGPL v3 or later. NETWORK COPYLEFT: run a

 *  Site           : https://vd.priv8.ru
 *  Source         : https://github.com/VD171/VD-Google
 *  GitHub         : @VD171 https://github.com/VD171
 *  XDA-Developers : @VD171 https://xdaforums.com/m/vd171.4699873/
 *  XDA thread     : https://xdaforums.com/t/VD-Google.4803837/
 *  Telegram       : @VD_Priv8 https://t.me/VD_Priv8
 *  Channel        : @Priv8_VD https://t.me/Priv8_VD
 *  Discord        : @VD.Priv8 https://discord.com/users/1296831918989639721
 *  E-mail         : vd.priv8@pm.me
 * ======================================================================
 */
package ru.vd171.vdgoogle.util

import android.content.Context
import android.content.res.Configuration
import java.util.Locale

object LocalePrefs {

    private const val PREF = "settings"
    private const val KEY_LANG = "lang"
    private const val KEY_CHOSEN = "lang_chosen"

    val LANGUAGES: List<Pair<String, String>> = listOf(
        "" to "",
        "en" to "English",
        "ar" to "العربية",
        "cs" to "Čeština",
        "de" to "Deutsch",
        "es" to "Español",
        "fa" to "فارسی",
        "fr" to "Français",
        "hi" to "हिन्दी",
        "in" to "Bahasa Indonesia",
        "it" to "Italiano",
        "ja" to "日本語",
        "ko" to "한국어",
        "nl" to "Nederlands",
        "pl" to "Polski",
        "pt" to "Português",
        "ru" to "Русский",
        "sv" to "Svenska",
        "th" to "ไทย",
        "tr" to "Türkçe",
        "uk" to "Українська",
        "vi" to "Tiếng Việt",
        "zh" to "中文",
    )

    private fun sp(c: Context) = c.getSharedPreferences(PREF, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

    fun lang(c: Context): String = runCatching { sp(c).getString(KEY_LANG, "") ?: "" }.getOrDefault("")

    fun setLang(c: Context, code: String) = runCatching { sp(c).edit().putString(KEY_LANG, code).apply() }.let {}

    fun chosen(c: Context): Boolean = runCatching { sp(c).getBoolean(KEY_CHOSEN, false) }.getOrDefault(false)

    fun markChosen(c: Context) = runCatching { sp(c).edit().putBoolean(KEY_CHOSEN, true).apply() }.let {}

    fun wrap(base: Context): Context {
        val code = lang(base)
        if (code.isEmpty()) return base
        val locale = Locale(code)
        Locale.setDefault(locale)
        val cfg = Configuration(base.resources.configuration)
        cfg.setLocale(locale)
        return base.createConfigurationContext(cfg)
    }
}
```

```
#!/bin/sh

#

# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.
#

##############################################################################
#
#   Gradle start up script for POSIX generated by Gradle.
#
#   Important for running:
#
#   (1) You need a POSIX-compliant shell to run this script. If your /bin/sh is
#       noncompliant, but you have some other compliant shell such as ksh or
#       bash, then to run this script, type that shell name before the whole
#       command line, like:
#
#           ksh Gradle
#
#       Busybox and similar reduced shells will NOT work, because this script
#       requires all of these POSIX shell features:
#         * functions;
#         * expansions «$var», «${var}», «${var:-default}», «${var+SET}»,
#           «${var#prefix}», «${var%suffix}», and «$( cmd )»;
#         * compound commands having a testable exit status, especially «case»;
#         * various built-in commands including «command», «set», and «ulimit».
#
#   Important for patching:
#
#   (2) This script targets any POSIX shell, so it avoids extensions provided
#       by Bash, Ksh, etc; in particular arrays are avoided.
#
#       The "traditional" practice of packing multiple parameters into a
#       space-separated string is a well documented source of bugs and security
#       problems, so this is (mostly) avoided, by progressively accumulating
#       options in "$@", and eventually passing that to Java.
#
#       Where the inherited environment variables (DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS,
#       and GRADLE_OPTS) rely on word-splitting, this is performed explicitly;
#       see the in-line comments for details.
#
#       There are tweaks for specific operating systems such as AIX, CygWin,
#       Darwin, MinGW, and NonStop.
#
#   (3) This script is generated from the Groovy template
#       https://github.com/gradle/gradle/blob/HEAD/subprojects/plugins/src/main/resources/org/gradle/api/internal/plugins/unixStartScript.txt
#       within the Gradle project.
#
#       You can find Gradle at https://github.com/gradle/gradle/.
#
##############################################################################

# Attempt to set APP_HOME

# Resolve links: $0 may be a link
app_path=$0

# Need this for daisy-chained symlinks.
while
    APP_HOME=${app_path%"${app_path##*/}"}  # leaves a trailing /; empty if no leading path
    [ -h "$app_path" ]
do
    ls=$( ls -ld "$app_path" )
    link=${ls#*' -> '}
    case $link in             #(
      /*)   app_path=$link ;; #(
      *)    app_path=$APP_HOME$link ;;
    esac
done

# This is normally unused
# shellcheck disable=SC2034
APP_BASE_NAME=${0##*/}
# Discard cd standard output in case $CDPATH is set (https://github.com/gradle/gradle/issues/25036)
APP_HOME=$( cd "${APP_HOME:-./}" > /dev/null && pwd -P ) || exit

# Use the maximum available, or set MAX_FD != -1 to use that value.
MAX_FD=maximum

warn () {
    echo "$*"
} >&2

die () {
    echo
    echo "$*"
    echo
    exit 1
} >&2

# OS specific support (must be 'true' or 'false').
cygwin=false
msys=false
darwin=false
nonstop=false
case "$( uname )" in                #(
  CYGWIN* )         cygwin=true  ;; #(
  Darwin* )         darwin=true  ;; #(
  MSYS* | MINGW* )  msys=true    ;; #(
  NONSTOP* )        nonstop=true ;;
esac

CLASSPATH=$APP_HOME/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar


# Determine the Java command to use to start the JVM.
if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
    if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
        # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java
    else
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/bin/java
    fi
    if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: $JAVA_HOME

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
else
    JAVACMD=java
    if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1
    then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH.

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
fi

# Increase the maximum file descriptors if we can.
if ! "$cygwin" && ! "$darwin" && ! "$nonstop" ; then
    case $MAX_FD in #(
      max*)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -H is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        MAX_FD=$( ulimit -H -n ) ||
            warn "Could not query maximum file descriptor limit"
    esac
    case $MAX_FD in  #(
      '' | soft) :;; #(
      *)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -n is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        ulimit -n "$MAX_FD" ||
            warn "Could not set maximum file descriptor limit to $MAX_FD"
    esac
fi

# Collect all arguments for the java command, stacking in reverse order:
#   * args from the command line
#   * the main class name
#   * -classpath
#   * -D...appname settings
#   * --module-path (only if needed)
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and GRADLE_OPTS environment variables.

# For Cygwin or MSYS, switch paths to Windows format before running java
if "$cygwin" || "$msys" ; then
    APP_HOME=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$APP_HOME" )
    CLASSPATH=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$CLASSPATH" )

    JAVACMD=$( cygpath --unix "$JAVACMD" )

    # Now convert the arguments - kludge to limit ourselves to /bin/sh
    for arg do
        if
            case $arg in                                #(
              -*)   false ;;                            # don't mess with options #(
              /?*)  t=${arg#/} t=/${t%%/*}              # looks like a POSIX filepath
                    [ -e "$t" ] ;;                      #(
              *)    false ;;
            esac
        then
            arg=$( cygpath --path --ignore --mixed "$arg" )
        fi
        # Roll the args list around exactly as many times as the number of
        # args, so each arg winds up back in the position where it started, but
        # possibly modified.
        #
        # NB: a `for` loop captures its iteration list before it begins, so
        # changing the positional parameters here affects neither the number of
        # iterations, nor the values presented in `arg`.
        shift                   # remove old arg
        set -- "$@" "$arg"      # push replacement arg
    done
fi


# Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS='"-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"'

# Collect all arguments for the java command:
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and optsEnvironmentVar are not allowed to contain shell fragments,
#     and any embedded shellness will be escaped.
#   * For example: A user cannot expect ${Hostname} to be expanded, as it is an environment variable and will be
#     treated as '${Hostname}' itself on the command line.

set -- \
        "-Dorg.gradle.appname=$APP_BASE_NAME" \
        -classpath "$CLASSPATH" \
        org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain \
        "$@"

# Stop when "xargs" is not available.
if ! command -v xargs >/dev/null 2>&1
then
    die "xargs is not available"
fi

# Use "xargs" to parse quoted args.
#
# With -n1 it outputs one arg per line, with the quotes and backslashes removed.
#
# In Bash we could simply go:
#
#   readarray ARGS < <( xargs -n1 <<<"$var" ) &&
#   set -- "${ARGS[@]}" "$@"
#
# but POSIX shell has neither arrays nor command substitution, so instead we
# post-process each arg (as a line of input to sed) to backslash-escape any
# character that might be a shell metacharacter, then use eval to reverse
# that process (while maintaining the separation between arguments), and wrap
# the whole thing up as a single "set" statement.
#
# This will of course break if any of these variables contains a newline or
# an unmatched quote.
#

eval "set -- $(
        printf '%s\n' "$DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS $GRADLE_OPTS" |
        xargs -n1 |
        sed ' s~[^-[:alnum:]+,./:=@_]~\\&~g; ' |
        tr '\n' ' '
    )" '"$@"'

exec "$JAVACMD" "$@"
```

```py
# ======================================================================

#  RCS, Google Wallet and Play Integrity attestations: local, no internet.

#  Free software under the GNU AGPL v3 or later. NETWORK COPYLEFT: run a

#
#  Site           : https://vd171.ru
#  Site           : https://vd.priv8.ru
#  Source         : https://github.com/VD171/VD-Google
#  GitHub         : @VD171 https://github.com/VD171
#  XDA-Developers : @VD171 https://xdaforums.com/m/vd171.4699873/
#  XDA thread     : https://xdaforums.com/t/VD-Google.4803837/
#  Telegram       : @VD_Priv8 https://t.me/VD_Priv8
#  Channel        : @Priv8_VD https://t.me/Priv8_VD
#  Discord        : @VD.Priv8 https://discord.com/users/1296831918989639721
#  E-mail         : vd.priv8@pm.me
# ======================================================================
#
#  WebUI screenshot harness. Renders the real webui/webroot in a headless
#  Chrome under a mocked `ksu.exec` bridge. The webroot ships RAW shell to
#  ksu.exec and parses the stdout itself, so the mock answers each reader
#  (RCS, Wallet, Play Integrity attestations) with fictional, privacy-safe
#  fixtures (NEVER real device or account data), then captures the five
#  documented tabs in each of the 22 languages. A synthetic device chrome
#  (status bar + nav bar) frames the shot; the in-page app bar is the
#  product banner. Output: docs/screenshots/<lang>/.
#
#  Why this lives in the repo:
#   - every label, the app list and the RTL mirroring come from the live
#     webroot + lang/*.json, so a UI or string change shows on the next run
#     with no edit here;
#   - the shown version is read from webui/module.prop, so a release bump
#     needs no change here either;
#   - fixtures are declared once below; extend a reader branch when the UI
#     starts reading a new source.
#
#  Usage:
#     python3 tools/screenshots/shoot.py            # all 22 languages
#     python3 tools/screenshots/shoot.py pt en ar   # only the given codes
#  Requires: python3-playwright + a system Google Chrome/Chromium.
# ======================================================================

import datetime

from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler

         "ko", "nl", "pl", "pt", "ru", "sv", "th", "tr", "uk", "vi", "zh"]

    ("about", "about"),
    ("droidguard", "droidguard"),
    ("rcs", "rcs"),
    ("wallet", "wallet"),
    ("att", "attestations"),

def module_version():
    try:
        with open(MODULE_PROP, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for line in f:
                if line.startswith("version="):
                    return line.split("=", 1)[1].strip()
    except OSError:
        pass
    return "v1.0"


def ms(y, mo, d, h, mi, s=0):
    return int(datetime.datetime(y, mo, d, h, mi, s, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp() * 1000)


def secs(y, mo, d, h, mi, s=0):
    return ms(y, mo, d, h, mi, s) // 1000


def kvblock(pairs):
    return "".join("%s=%s\n" % (k, "" if v is None else v) for (k, v) in pairs)


def build_fixtures(version):
    # Fictional, privacy-safe sample state: RCS set up and working, a Google
    # Wallet attestation present, a Play Integrity / DroidGuard verdict with
    # the device-certified label and a few attesting apps. All invented;
    # NEVER derived from a real device, SIM, carrier or Google account.
    rcs = kvblock([

    att_apps = [

MOCK_JS = r"""
(function () {
  window.__VDG_FIX = %s;
  window.__VDG_LANG = "%s";
  try { localStorage.setItem("vdgoogle_lang", window.__VDG_LANG); } catch (e) {}
  function reply(cmd) {
    var f = window.__VDG_FIX;
    if (/module\.prop/.test(cmd) && /version=/.test(cmd)) return f.version + "\n";
    if (/---TABLES---/.test(cmd)) return "";
    if (/ro\.product\.model/.test(cmd)) return f.dev;
    if (/---DG---/.test(cmd)) return f.att;
    if (/is_rcs_available/.test(cmd)) return f.rcs;
    if (/tapandpay/i.test(cmd)) return f.wallet;
    return "";
  }
  window.ksu = {
    exec: function (cmd, opts, cbName) {
      var out = reply(String(cmd));
      setTimeout(function () {
        try { if (typeof window[cbName] === "function") window[cbName](0, out, ""); } catch (e) {}
      }, 0);
    }
  };
})();
"""

  document.head.appendChild(css);
  var sb = document.createElement('div');

  document.body.appendChild(sb);

SELECT_JS = r"""
(function (tab) {
  var b = document.querySelector('.tab[data-tab="' + tab + '"]');
  if (b) b.click();
  var a = document.querySelector('.tab.active');
  var strip = document.getElementById('tabs');
  if (a && strip) strip.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, a.offsetLeft - 60);
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
})
"""


def serve(directory):
    handler = lambda *a, **k: SimpleHTTPRequestHandler(*a, directory=directory, **k)
    httpd = socketserver.ThreadingTCPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), handler)
    httpd.daemon_threads = True
    threading.Thread(target=httpd.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    return httpd, httpd.server_address[1]


def main(argv):
    langs = [a for a in argv[1:] if a in LANGS] or LANGS
    version = module_version()
    fixtures = build_fixtures(version)
    fix_json = json.dumps(fixtures, ensure_ascii=False)
    httpd, port = serve(WEBROOT)
    base = "http://127.0.0.1:%d/index.html" % port
    total = 0
    with sync_playwright() as pw:
        browser = pw.chromium.launch(channel="chrome", headless=True,
                                     args=["--force-color-profile=srgb"])
        try:
            for lang in langs:
                ctx = browser.new_context(viewport=VIEWPORT, device_scale_factor=SCALE,
                                          locale=lang, timezone_id=TZID)
                page = ctx.new_page()
                page.add_init_script(MOCK_JS % (fix_json, lang))
                page.goto(base, wait_until="networkidle")
                page.wait_for_timeout(600)   # let init() + helper microtasks settle
                page.evaluate(CHROME_JS)
                outlang = os.path.join(OUTDIR, lang)
                os.makedirs(outlang, exist_ok=True)
                for tab, name in SCREENS:
                    page.evaluate(SELECT_JS, tab)
                    page.wait_for_timeout(500)   # async ksu reply + render
                    page.evaluate(CHROME_JS)     # re-assert chrome after any reflow
                    page.wait_for_timeout(60)
                    page.screenshot(path=os.path.join(outlang, "%s.png" % name))
                    total += 1
                ctx.close()
                print("  %s: %d screens" % (lang, len(SCREENS)))
        finally:
            browser.close()
    httpd.shutdown()
    print("done: %d PNGs (%d langs) at version %s -> %s" %
          (total, len(langs), version, OUTDIR))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv)
```

`VDGoogle/webui/customize.sh`:

```sh
# ======================================================================
#  VD GOOGLE  ::  your Google services, read on-device
#  RCS, Google Wallet and Play Integrity attestations: local, no internet.
#
#  Copyright (C) 2026  VD171
#  SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later
#
#  Free software under the GNU AGPL v3 or later. NETWORK COPYLEFT: run a
#  modified version, even as a service, and you MUST offer its source.
#
#  Site           : https://vd171.ru
#  Site           : https://vd.priv8.ru
#  Source         : https://github.com/VD171/VD-Google
#  GitHub         : @VD171 https://github.com/VD171
#  XDA-Developers : @VD171 https://xdaforums.com/m/vd171.4699873/
#  XDA thread     : https://xdaforums.com/t/VD-Google.4803837/
#  Telegram       : @VD_Priv8 https://t.me/VD_Priv8
#  Channel        : @Priv8_VD https://t.me/Priv8_VD
#  Discord        : @VD.Priv8 https://discord.com/users/1296831918989639721
#  E-mail         : vd.priv8@pm.me
# ======================================================================

ui_print ""
ui_print "  VD Google"
MODULE_VERSION=$(grep_prop version "$MODPATH/module.prop")
MODULE_VERSION_CODE=$(grep_prop versionCode "$MODPATH/module.prop")
ui_print "  version $MODULE_VERSION (versionCode $MODULE_VERSION_CODE)"
ui_print ""

if ! $BOOTMODE; then
  ui_print "  ! Install from Magisk, KernelSU or APatch, not recovery."
  abort "  ! Recovery install is not supported."
fi

if [ "$API" -lt 26 ]; then
  ui_print "  ! Android 8.0 (API 26) or newer is required."
  abort "  ! Android version is too old."
fi

. "$MODPATH/.vd/sha256-gate.sh"

VDG_ARCH="$ARCH"
[ -z "$VDG_ARCH" ] && case "$(getprop ro.product.cpu.abi)" in arm64*) VDG_ARCH=arm64 ;; x86_64) VDG_ARCH=x64 ;; x86) VDG_ARCH=x86 ;; arm*) VDG_ARCH=arm ;; *) VDG_ARCH=other ;; esac
case "$VDG_ARCH" in
  arm64) BINABI=arm64-v8a ;;
  arm)   BINABI=armeabi-v7a ;;
  x64)   BINABI=x86_64 ;;
  x86)   BINABI=x86 ;;
  *) ui_print "  ! Unsupported CPU ($VDG_ARCH); VD Google needs arm, arm64, x86 or x86_64."; abort "  ! Unsupported architecture." ;;
esac

PROV="$MODPATH/bin/$BINABI/PROVENANCE.json"
if [ -f "$PROV" ]; then
  ui_print "  Verifying bundled binaries ($BINABI)..."
  VDG_FAIL=0
  for f in "$MODPATH/bin/$BINABI/sqlite3" "$MODPATH/bin/$BINABI/lib/"*; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    case "$f" in *.sha256) continue ;; esac
    rel=${f#"$MODPATH/bin/$BINABI/"}
    want=$(grep "\"path\": \"$rel\"" "$PROV" | grep -oE '[0-9a-f]{64}' | head -1)
    got=$(sha256sum "$f" 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1)
    if [ -z "$want" ]; then ui_print "  ! no recorded checksum for $rel"; VDG_FAIL=1
    elif [ "$want" != "$got" ]; then ui_print "  ! checksum mismatch: $rel"; VDG_FAIL=1; fi
  done
  [ "$VDG_FAIL" = 1 ] && abort "  ! Bundled binary verification failed; not installing."
  ui_print "  Binaries verified."
  ui_print ""
fi

ui_print "  Open the WebUI from your root manager (gear icon on this module)."
ui_print "  It reads on-device only. The app has no internet access."
ui_print ""

set_perm_recursive "$MODPATH/bin" 0 0 0755 0755
set_perm_recursive "$MODPATH/webroot" 0 0 0755 0644

MID="${MODID:-$(grep_prop id "$MODPATH/module.prop")}"
ACTIVE="/data/adb/modules/$MID"
if [ "$BOOTMODE" = "true" ] && [ -n "$MID" ] && [ "$MODPATH" != "$ACTIVE" ]; then
  rm -rf "$ACTIVE.new"
  if cp -af "$MODPATH" "$ACTIVE.new" 2>/dev/null; then
    rm -rf "$ACTIVE"
    mv "$ACTIVE.new" "$ACTIVE"
    rm -f "$ACTIVE/update" "$ACTIVE/remove" "$ACTIVE/disable"
    setsid sh -c "n=0; while [ \$n -lt 30 ]; do rm -f '$ACTIVE/update' '$ACTIVE/remove' '$ACTIVE/disable'; sleep 1; n=\$((n+1)); done" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    ui_print "  Activated now, no reboot needed."
  else
    rm -rf "$ACTIVE.new"
    ui_print "  ! Live activation failed; active after a reboot."
  fi
  ui_print ""
fi
```

`VDGoogle/webui/package.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ======================================================================
#  VD GOOGLE  ::  your Google services, read on-device
#  RCS, Google Wallet and Play Integrity attestations: local, no internet.
#
#  Copyright (C) 2026  VD171
#  SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later
#
#  Free software under the GNU AGPL v3 or later. NETWORK COPYLEFT: run a
#  modified version, even as a service, and you MUST offer its source.
#
#  Site           : https://vd171.ru
#  Site           : https://vd.priv8.ru
#  Source         : https://github.com/VD171/VD-Google
#  GitHub         : @VD171 https://github.com/VD171
#  XDA-Developers : @VD171 https://xdaforums.com/m/vd171.4699873/
#  XDA thread     : https://xdaforums.com/t/VD-Google.4803837/
#  Telegram       : @VD_Priv8 https://t.me/VD_Priv8
#  Channel        : @Priv8_VD https://t.me/Priv8_VD
#  Discord        : @VD.Priv8 https://discord.com/users/1296831918989639721
#  E-mail         : vd.priv8@pm.me
# ======================================================================
set -eu

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
VERSION="$(sed -n 's/^version=//p' "$HERE/module.prop" | head -1)"
OUT_DIR="$(cd "$HERE/../.." && pwd)/dist"
ZIP="$OUT_DIR/VDGoogle-WebUI-${VERSION}.zip"

mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"
rm -f "$ZIP"

cd "$HERE"
STAGE="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$STAGE"' EXIT
cp -a module.prop customize.sh uninstall.sh update.json META-INF bin webroot .vd "$STAGE/"
find "$STAGE" -name '.git*' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
sh "$HERE/../../.github/scripts/gen-sha256.sh" "$STAGE" >/dev/null
( cd "$STAGE" && zip -r9 -X "$ZIP" . -x './.git*' >/dev/null )

echo "built $ZIP"
unzip -l "$ZIP" | tail -n 1

```

`VDGoogle/webui/webroot/i18n.js`:

```js
/*
 * ======================================================================
 *  VD GOOGLE  ::  your Google services, read on-device
 *  RCS, Google Wallet and Play Integrity attestations: local, no internet.
 *
 *  Copyright (C) 2026  VD171
 *  SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later
 *
 *  Free software under the GNU AGPL v3 or later. NETWORK COPYLEFT: run a
 *  modified version, even as a service, and you MUST offer its source.
 *
 *  Site           : https://vd171.ru
 *  Site           : https://vd.priv8.ru
 *  Source         : https://github.com/VD171/VD-Google
 *  GitHub         : @VD171 https://github.com/VD171
 *  XDA-Developers : @VD171 https://xdaforums.com/m/vd171.4699873/
 *  XDA thread     : https://xdaforums.com/t/VD-Google.4803837/
 *  Telegram       : @VD_Priv8 https://t.me/VD_Priv8
 *  Channel        : @Priv8_VD https://t.me/Priv8_VD
 *  Discord        : @VD.Priv8 https://discord.com/users/1296831918989639721
 *  E-mail         : vd.priv8@pm.me
 * ======================================================================
 */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var AVAILABLE = ["en", "ar", "cs", "de", "es", "fa", "fr", "hi", "id", "it", "ja",
                   "ko", "nl", "pl", "pt", "ru", "sv", "th", "tr", "uk", "vi", "zh"];
  var NAMES = {
    en: "English", ar: "العربية", cs: "Čeština", de: "Deutsch", es: "Español",
    fa: "فارسی", fr: "Français", hi: "हिन्दी", id: "Bahasa Indonesia", it: "Italiano",
    ja: "日本語", ko: "한국어", nl: "Nederlands", pl: "Polski", pt: "Português",
    ru: "Русский", sv: "Svenska", th: "ไทย", tr: "Türkçe", uk: "Українська", vi: "Tiếng Việt", zh: "中文"
  };
  var RTL = { ar: 1, fa: 1 };
  var dict = {}, fallback = (window.__I18N_EN || {});

  function pick() {
    try { var s = localStorage.getItem("vdgoogle_lang"); if (s && AVAILABLE.indexOf(s) >= 0) return s; } catch (e) {}
    var n = (navigator.language || "en").toLowerCase();
    if (AVAILABLE.indexOf(n) >= 0) return n;
    var base = n.split("-")[0];
    if (base === "in") return "id";
    if (AVAILABLE.indexOf(base) >= 0) return base;
    return "en";
  }

  async function fetchJson(path) {
    try { var r = await fetch(path, { cache: "no-store" }); return r.ok ? await r.json() : {}; }
    catch (e) { return {}; }
  }

  async function load(lang) {
    if (lang === "en") { dict = fallback; return; }
    var d = await fetchJson("lang/" + lang + ".json");
    dict = Object.keys(d).length ? d : fallback;
  }

  function t(key, a1) {
    var s = dict[key]; if (s == null) s = fallback[key]; if (s == null) s = key;
    if (a1 != null) s = s.split("%1$s").join(a1);
    return s;
  }

  function apply(root) {
    var r = root || document;
    r.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n]").forEach(function (el) { el.textContent = t(el.getAttribute("data-i18n")); });
    r.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n-ph]").forEach(function (el) { el.setAttribute("placeholder", t(el.getAttribute("data-i18n-ph"))); });
    r.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n-title]").forEach(function (el) { el.setAttribute("title", t(el.getAttribute("data-i18n-title"))); });
  }

  window.I18N = {
    AVAILABLE: AVAILABLE,
    NAMES: NAMES,
    current: "en",
    t: t,
    apply: apply,
    isRtl: function () { return !!RTL[this.current]; },
    async init() {
      this.current = pick();
      await load(this.current);
      document.documentElement.lang = this.current;
      document.documentElement.dir = this.isRtl() ? "rtl" : "ltr";
      apply(document);
    },
    async set(lang) {
      this.current = lang;
      try { localStorage.setItem("vdgoogle_lang", lang); } catch (e) {}
      await load(lang);
      document.documentElement.lang = lang;
      document.documentElement.dir = this.isRtl() ? "rtl" : "ltr";
      apply(document);
    }
  };
  window.t = t;
})();

```

```js
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function ex(c) {
    return new Promise(function (ok, no) {
      var n = "c" + Date.now() + "_" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7);
      window[n] = function (e, o, r) { delete window[n]; e === 0 ? ok(o || "") : no(r || "err " + e); };
      if (typeof ksu !== "undefined" && ksu.exec) ksu.exec(c, "{}", n);
      else { delete window[n]; no("KSU API unavailable"); }
    });
  }

  function hasRoot() { return typeof ksu !== "undefined" && !!ksu.exec; }

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", "\"": "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c];
    });
  }
  function pad(n) { return n < 10 ? "0" + n : "" + n; }
  function stamp() {
    var d = new Date();
    return "" + d.getFullYear() + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + pad(d.getDate()) + "-" + pad(d.getHours()) + pad(d.getMinutes());
  }
  function kv(out) {
    var m = {};
    (out || "").split("\n").forEach(function (l) {
      var i = l.indexOf("=");
      if (i > 0) m[l.slice(0, i)] = l.slice(i + 1).trim();
    });
    return m;
  }
  function blank(v) { return v == null || v === "" || v === "null"; }
  function val(v) { return blank(v) ? null : String(v).trim(); }

  function truthy(v) {
    switch ((v == null ? "" : String(v)).trim().toLowerCase()) {
      case "1": case "true": case "yes": case "enabled": case "available": return true;
      case "0": case "false": case "no": case "disabled": return false;
      default: return null;
    }
  }

  function tsMs(ms) {
    ms = Number(ms);
    if (!ms || ms <= 0) return null;
    var d = new Date(ms);
    return d.getFullYear() + "-" + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + pad(d.getDate()) +
      " " + pad(d.getHours()) + ":" + pad(d.getMinutes()) + ":" + pad(d.getSeconds());
  }
  function tsSecs(s) { s = Number(s); return s ? tsMs(s * 1000) : null; }

  function durationSecs(secs) {
    secs = Number(secs);
    if (!secs || secs <= 0) return null;
    var d = Math.floor(secs / 86400), h = Math.floor((secs % 86400) / 3600), m = Math.floor((secs % 3600) / 60);
    var s = "";
    if (d > 0) s += d + "d ";
    if (h > 0) s += h + "h ";
    if (m > 0 || s === "") s += m + "m";
    return s.trim();
  }

  function tzLabel() {
    var off = -new Date().getTimezoneOffset();
    var sign = off >= 0 ? "+" : "-", a = Math.abs(off);
    var gmt = "GMT" + sign + pad(Math.floor(a / 60)) + ":" + pad(a % 60);
    try {
      var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { timeZoneName: "short" }).formatToParts(new Date());
      var tz = parts.filter(function (p) { return p.type === "timeZoneName"; })[0];
      if (tz && tz.value && !/GMT|UTC/.test(tz.value) && tz.value !== gmt) return gmt + " (" + tz.value + ")";
    } catch (e) {}
    return gmt;
  }

  function carrierLabel(name, mcc, mnc) {
    var nm = val(name); if (nm && nm.toLowerCase() === "null") nm = null;
    var mc = val(mcc), mn = val(mnc);
    if (nm && mc) return nm + " (" + mc + "/" + (mn || "") + ")";
    if (nm) return nm;
    if (mc) return mc + "/" + (mn || "");
    return null;
  }
  function propCarrier(nameRaw, numericRaw) {
    var name = val(nameRaw ? nameRaw.split(",")[0] : null);
    var numS = numericRaw ? numericRaw.split(",")[0].trim() : "";
    var num = numS.length >= 5 ? numS : null;
    return carrierLabel(name, num ? num.slice(0, 3) : null, num ? num.slice(3) : null);
  }
  function domainCarrier(domain) {
    if (blank(domain)) return null;
    var head = String(domain).split(".rcs.")[0];
    if (!head) return null;
    var token = head.split("-").pop().split(".").pop();
    if (!token) return null;
    return token.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + token.slice(1);
  }

  async function readAtt() {
    var cmd = PRE +
      "V=/data/data/com.android.vending/shared_prefs\n" +

      "echo '---TS---'\n" +
      "cat $V/integrity_service_sharedprefs_timestamp_of_last_call.xml 2>/dev/null\n" +
      "echo '---CNT---'\n" +
      "cat $V/integrity_service_sharedprefs_number_of_calls_in_throttling_window.xml 2>/dev/null\n" +
      "echo '---CERT---'\n" +
      "od -An -tu1 -N2 \"$DEV\" 2>/dev/null\n" +

      "sq $Q/dg.db \"SELECT a, b, h FROM main ORDER BY b DESC\" 2>/dev/null\n" +

    var out = await ex(cmd);
    var dgPart = out.split("---DG---")[1] || "";
    var beforeDg = out.split("---DG---")[0] || "";
    var certPart = beforeDg.split("---CERT---")[1] || "";
    var head = beforeDg.split("---CERT---")[0] || "";
    var parts = head.split("---CNT---");
    var tsBlock = (parts[0] || "").split("---TS---").pop();
    var cntBlock = parts[1] || "";
    var counts = {};
    (cntBlock.match(/<long name="([^"]+)" value="(\d+)"/g) || []).forEach(function (m) {
      var g = /<long name="([^"]+)" value="(\d+)"/.exec(m);
      if (g) counts[g[1]] = g[2];
    });
    var apps = [];
    (tsBlock.match(/<long name="([^"]+)" value="(\d+)"/g) || []).forEach(function (m) {
      var g = /<long name="([^"]+)" value="(\d+)"/.exec(m);
      if (g) apps.push({ pkg: g[1], ts: Number(g[2]), calls: counts[g[1]] || "1" });
    });
    apps.sort(function (a, b) { return b.ts - a.ts; });
    var ct = certPart.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    var certified = (ct.length >= 2 && ct[0] === "8") ? (ct[1] === "1" ? "true" : "false") : null;
    var dg = [], dgSeen = {};
    dgPart.split("\n").forEach(function (l) {
      l = l.trim(); if (!l) return;
      var p = l.split("|");
      if (p.length < 3) return;
      var h = Number(p[p.length - 1]), b = Number(p[p.length - 2]);
      var flow = p.slice(0, p.length - 2).join("|").split("/")[0];
      if (flow && !dgSeen[flow]) { dgSeen[flow] = 1; dg.push({ flow: flow, issued: b, expiry: h }); }
    });
    return { apps: apps, certified: certified, droidGuard: dg };
  }

    var phBlk = blk("---PH---", "---END---");
    var flags = {};
    var fre = /name="(RcsFlags__[A-Za-z0-9_]+|notify_backend_rcs_is_unavailable)"\s+value="(true|false)"/g, fm;
    while ((fm = fre.exec(phBlk)) !== null) flags[fm[1]] = fm[2] === "true";

    var md = { opened: tables.length > 0, tables: tables };
    if (d.ptotal !== undefined && d.ptotal !== "") {
      md.participants = { total: jlong(d.ptotal), rcsAvailable1: jlong(d.pavail1) };
    }
    if (d.captotal !== undefined && d.captotal !== "") {
      md.capabilitiesCache = {
        total: jlong(d.captotal),
        withRcsTag3gpp: jlong(d.cap3gpp),
        freshLast30d: jlong(d.capfresh),
        blobMin: jlong(d.capmin),
        blobMax: jlong(d.capmax)
      };
    }
    md.rcsMessages = jlong(d.rcsmsg);
    md.columns = {
      participants: cPart,
      rcs_remote_capabilities_cache: cCap,
      messages: cMsg,
      self_participants: cSelf
    };

    return {
      sqliteVersion: js(d.sqlver),
      messagesDb: md,
      phenotypeRcsFlags: flags,
      telephonyDb: { siminfoRows: jlong(d.simrows), dataSub: jlong(d.datasub), columns: { siminfo: cSim } },
      droidguardDb: { tables: dgTables, mainColumns: dgCols, mainCount: jlong(d.dgcount) },
      packages: { messages: js(d.pkgmsg), gms: js(d.pkggms), vending: js(d.pkgvending) }
    };
  }

  function rcsHealth(d) {
    var enabled = truthy(d.rcsenabled);
    var version = parseInt(d.mversion, 10) || 0;
    if (enabled === false) return "off";
    if (version > 0 || parseInt(d.pev2, 10) === 3) return "connected";
    if (d.engine === "ConfiguredState" || enabled === true) return "setup";
    return "unknown";
  }

  function provConfig(provB64) {
    var out = {};
    if (!provB64) return out;
    var prov;
    try { prov = atob(provB64); } catch (e) { return out; }
    var SK = /password|secret|token|user|identity|phone|iccid|msisdn|imsi|imei|cred|digest|cookie|acs/i;
    var SV = /cookie|secret|token|password|credential/i;
    var re = /&quot;(\w+)&quot;:(?:&quot;([^&]*)&quot;|(-?\d+)|(true|false))/g, m;
    while ((m = re.exec(prov)) !== null) {
      var key = m[1];
      if (key.length < 2 || SK.test(key)) continue;
      var raw = (m[2] !== undefined && m[2] !== "") ? m[2] : (m[3] !== undefined ? m[3] : m[4]);
      if (!raw || Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(out, key) || SV.test(raw)) continue;
      var value = raw.indexOf("\\u") < 0 ? raw : raw.replace(/\\u([0-9a-fA-F]{4})/g, function (_, h) { return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(h, 16)); });
      out[key] = (value.replace(/\D/g, "").length >= 8) ? "[redacted]" : value;
    }
    return out;
  }

  function jb(raw) {
    var s = (raw == null ? "" : String(raw)).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (s === "1" || s === "true" || s === "yes" || s === "enabled" || s === "available") return true;
    if (s === "0" || s === "false" || s === "no" || s === "disabled") return false;
    if (s === "") return null;
    return raw;
  }
  function jn(raw) {
    if (raw == null) return null;
    var s = String(raw).trim();
    if (s === "") return null;
    return /^-?\d+$/.test(s) ? parseInt(s, 10) : s;
  }
  function js(raw) {
    if (raw == null) return null;
    var s = String(raw);
    return s.trim() === "" ? null : s;
  }
  function jlong(raw) {
    var s = val(raw);
    return (s != null && /^-?\d+$/.test(s)) ? parseInt(s, 10) : null;
  }

  function toneCls(t) { return t ? " " + t : ""; }

  function row(label, value, tone, meaning) {
    var v = blank(value) ? "<span class=\"muted\">-</span>" : esc(value);
    var vc = blank(value) ? "" : toneCls(tone);
    return "<div class=\"row\"><div class=\"k\"><div class=\"label\">" + esc(label) + "</div>" +
      (meaning ? "<div class=\"meaning\">" + esc(meaning) + "</div>" : "") +
      "</div><div class=\"v" + vc + "\">" + v + "</div></div>";
  }

  function boolRow(label, raw, meaning, trueGood) {
    if (trueGood === undefined) trueGood = true;
    var b = truthy(raw);
    var disp = b === true ? t("v_yes") : b === false ? t("v_no") : (blank(raw) ? t("v_unknown") : raw);
    var tone = b === null ? "" : (b === trueGood ? "good" : "bad");
    return row(label, disp, tone, meaning);
  }

  function imsRow(label, raw, meaning, conn) {
    if (!conn) return boolRow(label, raw, meaning);
    var b = truthy(raw);
    return row(label, b === true ? t("v_yes") : b === false ? t("v_no") : val(raw), "", meaning);
  }

  function strip(chips) {
    return "<div class=\"strip\">" + chips.map(function (c) {
      return "<span class=\"chip\"><span class=\"dot " + c[1] + "\"></span>" + esc(c[0]) + "</span>";
    }).join("") + "</div>";
  }

  function tzFoot() { return "<div class=\"tzfoot\">" + esc(t("tz_footer").split("%1$s").join(tzLabel())) + "</div>"; }

  var revealed = false;

  function renderRcs(d) {
    var health = rcsHealth(d);
    var hWord = health === "connected" ? t("rcs_st_connected") : health === "off" ? t("rcs_st_off") : t("rcs_st_setup");
    var hTone = health === "connected" ? "good" : health === "off" ? "bad" : "warn";

    var carrier = carrierLabel(d.simname, d.simmcc, d.simmnc) ||
      propCarrier(d.gsmalpha, d.gsmnum) || domainCarrier(d.mdomain);

    var conn = health === "connected";
    var magicOk = truthy(d.magic) === true;
    var h = strip([[t("rcs_chip_active"), hTone], [t("rcs_chip_backend"), (truthy(d.ims) || Number(d.ims) > 0 || conn) ? "good" : "warn"], [t("rcs_chip_gemini"), conn ? "good" : "warn"], [t("rcs_chip_magic"), magicOk ? "good" : "warn"]]);

    if (health !== "connected" && d.mversion === "0") {
      h += "<div class=\"callout\">" + esc(t("rcs_callout_mversion_zero")) + "</div>";
    }

    h += "<div class=\"seclabel\">" + esc(t("rcs_sec_status")) + "</div><div class=\"card\">";
    h += row(t("rcs_connected"), hWord, hTone, t("rcs_connected_m"));
    h += row(t("rcs_carrier"), carrier, "", t("rcs_carrier_m"));
    var av = truthy(d.avail);
    h += row(t("rcs_available"), av === true ? t("v_yes") : av === false ? t("v_no") : val(d.avail), "", t("rcs_available_m"));
    if (!blank(d.selfnum)) {
      var num = String(d.selfnum);
      var masked = "•••• " + num.slice(-4);
      h += "<div class=\"row\"><div class=\"k\"><div class=\"label\">" + esc(t("rcs_self_number")) +
        "</div><div class=\"meaning\">" + esc(t("rcs_self_number_m")) + "</div></div><div class=\"v\">" +
        "<span id=\"selfnum\">" + esc(revealed ? num : masked) + "</span> " +
        "<button class=\"reveal\" data-act=\"reveal\">" + esc(revealed ? t("action_hide") : t("action_reveal")) + "</button></div></div>";
    }
    h += row(t("rcs_state"), val(d.rcsstate), "", t("rcs_state_m"));
    h += row(t("rcs_cfg_version"), val(d.mversion), d.mversion === "0" ? (health === "connected" ? "" : "bad") : !blank(d.mversion) ? "good" : "", t("rcs_cfg_version_m"));
    var invalid = val(d.invalid);
    if (invalid && !/UNSPECIFIED$/.test(invalid)) {
      h += row(t("rcs_invalid_reason"), invalid.replace(/^INVALID_CONFIG_REASON_/, ""), "warn", t("rcs_invalid_reason_m"));
    }
    h += row(t("rcs_capable"), val(d.cap), "", t("rcs_capable_m"));
    h += imsRow(t("rcs_flag_enabled"), d.flagen, t("rcs_flag_enabled_m"), conn);
    if (health !== "connected") h += boolRow(t("rcs_flag_unavailable"), d.flagun, t("rcs_flag_unavailable_m"), false);
    h += row(t("rcs_entitlement"), val(d.ent), "", t("rcs_entitlement_m"));
    h += imsRow(t("rcs_uce"), d.uce, t("rcs_uce_m"), conn);
    h += imsRow(t("rcs_ims_pkg"), Number(d.ims) > 0 ? "true" : "false", t("rcs_ims_pkg_m"), conn);
    h += "</div>";

    h += "<div class=\"seclabel\">" + esc(t("rcs_gemini_sec")) + "</div><div class=\"card\">";
    h += boolRow(t("rcs_magic_compose"), d.magic, t("rcs_magic_compose_m"));
    h += boolRow(t("rcs_aicore"), Number(d.aicore) > 0 ? "true" : "false", t("rcs_aicore_m"));
    h += row(t("rcs_gemini_chat"), conn ? t("v_yes") : t("v_no"), conn ? "good" : "warn", t("rcs_gemini_chat_m"));
    h += "</div>";

    h += "<div class=\"seclabel\">" + esc(t("rcs_sec_times")) + "</div><div class=\"card\">";
    h += row(t("rcs_cfg_updated"), tsSecs(d.cfgupd), "", t("rcs_cfg_updated_m"));
    h += row(t("rcs_cfg_validity"), durationSecs(d.cfgval), "", t("rcs_cfg_validity_m"));
    h += row(t("rcs_token_exp"), tsMs(d.tokenexp), "", t("rcs_token_exp_m"));
    h += row(t("rcs_prov_last"), tsSecs(d.provlast), "", t("rcs_prov_last_m"));
    h += row(t("rcs_prov_next"), tsSecs(d.provnext), "", t("rcs_prov_next_m"));
    h += row(t("rcs_msg_last"), tsMs(d.msglast), "", t("rcs_msg_last_m"));
    h += row(t("rcs_cap_refresh"), tsMs(d.caplast), "", t("rcs_cap_refresh_m"));
    h += row(t("rcs_full_sync"), tsMs(d.fullsync), "", t("rcs_full_sync_m"));
    h += row(t("rcs_last_sync"), tsMs(d.lastsync), "", t("rcs_last_sync_m"));
    h += "</div>" + tzFoot();
    return h;
  }

  function attList(apps) {
    var q = attQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    var shown = q ? apps.filter(function (a) { return a.pkg.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0; }) : apps;
    return shown.map(function (a) {

        "<div style=\"flex:1 1 auto; min-width:0\"><div class=\"pkg\">" + esc(a.pkg) + "</div>" +
        "<div class=\"meta\">" + esc(t("att_last_call").split("%1$s").join(tsMs(a.ts) || "-")) + "</div>" +
        "<div class=\"meta\">" + esc(t("att_calls").split("%1$s").join(a.calls)) + "</div></div></div>";
    }).join("");
  }

    return url
      ? "<div class=\"" + cls + "\" data-open=\"" + esc(url) + "\">" + inner + "</div>"
      : "<div class=\"" + cls + "\">" + inner + "</div>";
  }
```
